$comment: Every hook event hooks/hooks.json registers, with the outcomes its handler can return. The Stop block is `deny` in the runner's vocabulary (decision: block). Each event × outcome has one evals/<name>.scenario.json; `ledger gate check` fails naming any gap. `manual` lists what no scenario can prove.
manual: That the context-pressure measure (the token usage the last main-thread reply recorded in the transcript: input_tokens + cache_read_input_tokens + cache_creation_input_tokens) matches the real context on Claude Code: when the warning fires, run /context in the same session and compare its token figure with the one the ask gave. A warning that says `(estimate)` used the bytes / 8 fallback instead and can be off in either direction.

That the compaction-summary instructions the PreCompact hook prints as plain text reach Claude Code's summary: after a real compaction, check that the summary ends with a `## Handoff` section (In flight, Ruled out, Still open, Next step). No scenario can see the summary.
That the restored snapshot arrives in the model's context after a real auto-compaction: run a session past the ask point and ask it, after the compaction, what branch it was on.
